entities.blurb: Aqua Affinity is an enchantment applied to helmets that removes the mining speed reduction that occurs when underwater.
entities.name: Aqua Affinity

entities.blurb: Bane of Arthropods is an enchantment applied to swords, axes, spears, and maces that substantially increases melee damage against arthropod mobs and applies Slowness IV to them.
entities.name: Bane of Arthropods

entities.blurb: Curse of Binding is an enchantment that prevents the item from being removed from armor slots.
entities.name: Curse of Binding

entities.blurb: Blast Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that reduces damage taken from explosions and fireworks and increases explosion knockback resistance.
entities.name: Blast Protection

entities.blurb: Breach is an enchantment applied to maces that causes melee attacks to partially ignore armor, increasing damage against armored targets. It also affects the natural armor points that certain mobs have innately.
entities.name: Breach

entities.blurb: Channeling is an enchantment applied to tridents that causes a lightning strike when thrown at an entity or lightning rod during a thunderstorm‌[Java Edition  only] or at a lightning rod during any type of rain.‌[Bedrock Edition  only]
entities.name: Channeling

entities.blurb: Density is an enchantment applied to maces that increases the damage of smash attacks.
entities.name: Density

entities.blurb: Depth Strider is an enchantment applied to boots that lessens the movement speed reduction that occurs when in water.
entities.name: Depth Strider

entities.blurb: Efficiency is an enchantment applied to tools that increases mining efficiency.
entities.name: Efficiency

entities.blurb: Feather Falling is an enchantment applied to boots that reduces fall damage and ender pearl damage.
entities.name: Feather Falling

entities.blurb: Fire Aspect is an enchantment applied to swords, maces, and spears that ignites entities hit with melee attacks.
entities.name: Fire Aspect

entities.blurb: Fire Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that reduces damage received from fire. It also reduces burning time.
entities.name: Fire Protection

entities.blurb: Flame is an enchantment applied to bows that causes arrows shot by the bow to be set on fire.
entities.name: Flame

entities.blurb: Fortune is an enchantment applied to tools that gives a chance to receive more item drops from certain blocks.
entities.name: Fortune

entities.blurb: Frost Walker is an enchantment applied to boots that turns water into frosted ice beneath the user's feet, and provides immunity to campfire and magma block damage.
entities.name: Frost Walker

entities.blurb: Impaling is an enchantment applied to tridents that substantially increases damage against aquatic mobs,‌[JE  only] or increases damage against entities in water or rain.‌[BE  only]
entities.name: Impaling

entities.blurb: Infinity is an enchantment applied to bows that prevents consumption of arrows, except for spectral arrows or tipped arrows.
entities.name: Infinity

entities.blurb: Knockback is an enchantment applied to swords and spears that increases melee knockback.
entities.name: Knockback

entities.blurb: Looting is an enchantment applied to swords and spears  that gives a chance to receive more item drops from certain mobs.
entities.name: Looting

entities.blurb: Loyalty is an enchantment applied to tridents that causes a thrown trident to fly back to the player who threw it after it lands.
entities.name: Loyalty

entities.blurb: Luck of the Sea is an enchantment applied to fishing rods that increases the rate of treasure items from fishing.
entities.name: Luck of the Sea

entities.blurb: Lunge is an enchantment applied to spears that causes jab attacks to propel the wielder forward horizontally. When used, Lunge consumes saturation and hunger at an amount dependent on the enchantment level, as well as 1 durability. The distance gained from Lunge is increased when in midair.
entities.name: Lunge

entities.blurb: Lure is an enchantment applied to fishing rods that decreases the wait time for bites when fishing.
entities.name: Lure

entities.blurb: Mending is an enchantment that restores an item's durability when a player collects experience orbs.
entities.name: Mending

entities.blurb: Multishot is an enchantment applied to crossbows that makes firing one projectile shoot three copies of the same projectile in a fixed spread, at the cost of draining more durability.
entities.name: Multishot

entities.blurb: Piercing is an enchantment applied to crossbows that allows fired arrows to damage and fly through multiple entities, including shields, without being consumed.
entities.name: Piercing

entities.blurb: Power is an enchantment applied to bows that increases arrow damage.
entities.name: Power

entities.blurb: Projectile Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that reduces damage received from arrows, tridents, and any other projectiles.
entities.name: Projectile Protection

entities.blurb: Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that adds bonus damage reduction.
entities.name: Protection

entities.blurb: Punch is an enchantment applied to bows that increases arrow knockback.
entities.name: Punch

entities.blurb: Quick Charge is an enchantment applied to crossbows that reduces charge time.
entities.name: Quick Charge

entities.blurb: Respiration is an enchantment applied to helmets that extends underwater breathing time.
entities.name: Respiration

entities.blurb: Riptide is an enchantment applied to tridents that causes the trident to launch the user when used in water or rain, replacing the trident's ability to be thrown as a projectile.
entities.name: Riptide

entities.blurb: Sharpness is an enchantment applied to swords, axes, and spears that increases melee damage.
entities.name: Sharpness

entities.blurb: Silk Touch is an enchantment applied to tools that causes certain blocks to drop themselves instead of their normal drops.
entities.name: Silk Touch

entities.blurb: Smite is an enchantment applied to swords, axes, spears, and maces that substantially increases melee damage against undead mobs.
entities.name: Smite

entities.blurb: Soul Speed is an enchantment applied to boots that causes faster movement on soul sand and soul soil, but slowly drains durability in the process.
entities.name: Soul Speed

entities.blurb: Sweeping Edge is an enchantment applied to swords that increases sweep attack damage. This only affects the damage of the sweep attack against other surrounding entities, and does not increase damage against the entity that is attacked directly. Sweeping Edge is not required to do sweep attacks, as swords have the ability innately.​[until: JE Combat Tests]
entities.name: Sweeping Edge

entities.blurb: Swift Sneak is an enchantment applied to leggings that lessens the movement speed reduction that occurs when sneaking.
entities.name: Swift Sneak

entities.blurb: Thorns is an armor enchantment that gives a random chance to damage entities that attack the user, at the cost of increasing incurred durability damage.
entities.name: Thorns

entities.blurb: Unbreaking is an enchantment that gives a chance for an item to avoid durability reduction when it is used, effectively increasing the item's durability.
entities.name: Unbreaking

entities.blurb: Curse of Vanishing is an enchantment that causes the item to which it is applied to disappear upon death.
entities.name: Curse of Vanishing

entities.blurb: Wind Burst is an enchantment applied to maces that causes a powerful upward knockback effect to be created upon executing a smash attack. Unlike wind charges, Wind Burst does not negate fall damage.
entities.name: Wind Burst
